text:
lina: Starting canary for `release/2026-03-22` - routing 3% to the new runtime for /v1/chat/completions. Change window 09:00-13:00 PT. I'll watch SLOs for 20m. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-22 :mag:

deploy-bot: Canary started - job=canary-2026-03-22-3pct, target=chat, routing=3% :rocket:

tom: Observability: chat.completions.p95 jumped to ~720ms at 1717601280 (baseline ~320ms). Backend error rate moved 0.05% -> 0.6% in the last 3m. link: https://obs.redwood/dashboards/slo/chat-completions

sre-oncall: Alert firing: slo_alert(chat/p95>600ms,5m) for canary tag. Can you paste the alert filter?

tom: Filter used:
```
q = sum(rate(http_requests_total{route=\"/v1/chat/completions\",deploy_tag=\"canary\"}[5m]))
p95 = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=\"/v1/chat/completions\",deploy_tag=\"canary\"}[5m])) by (le))
(p95 > 0.6)
```

lina: Interesting that error spike accompanies p95. Traces show upstream grpc: "connection refused" and a cluster-level retry flood. Any config diffs in this release?

deploy-bot: Config diff uploaded: https://ci.redwood/config-diffs/2026-03-22/canary. Notable: changed model quantization from q8 -> q4-compat and updated kernel selector to prefer avx512 path on canary nodes.

tom: q4 can lead to instability on some infra combos, especially with the AVX kernel selection. Traces show memory alignment errors in several worker logs.

sre-oncall: Proposed immediate action: set canary routing to 0%, enable enhanced tracing, and pin quantization back to q8 for canary pool. Agree?

lina: I prefer a pause + pin rather than full rollback. Pause first. Also flag product for risk note.

product: Affected SLAs: a <1% user fraction saw degraded latency. We'll add a short note in the customer incident channel if this escalates.

/deploy pause canary job=canary-2026-03-22-3pct (requested by lina)

deploy-bot: Canary paused. Routing 0%. Traces sampling increased.

lina: Applying hotfix: set `model.quant = \"q8\"` for canary instances, and revert kernel-selector to legacy path. Then run a short synthetic replay at 5 rps.

deploy-bot: Config patch applied config-change-1717601365. Starting synthetic job synthetic-check-1717601370 at 5 rps for 90s. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/canary-2026-03-22/1717601375

tom: Synthetic replay shows p95 ~310ms, error rate ~0.01%. No memory alignment errors in worker logs.

sre-oncall: Good. Suggest we resume a limited ramp to 1.5% for 10m, observe. If p95 < 450ms and error_rate <0.2% we continue to 6%. If not, rollback.

lina: Agreed. Resume to 1.5% now. /deploy resume canary job=canary-2026-03-22-3pct target=1.5% (requested by lina)

deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 1.5%. Alert window set to 5m, high sampling.

product: Please add a line to release notes: "Mitigation: pinned quantization to q8 and reverted kernel-selector for canary after p95/error spike."

tom: Also adding a post-deploy action: add a regression test that exercises q4 path + avx kernel on our infra images before allowing rollout.

sre-oncall: I'll stay on pager for the next 20m. If we see error_rate > 0.5% or p95 > 600ms we execute full rollback: `deploy-bot rollback canary-2026-03-22 --full`.

lina: If 1.5% stays green we'll move to 6% after 10m. Marking current canary run as "paused->pinned->resumed(1.5%)" in the ticket. https://internal.redwood/tasks/REL-2026-03-22

deploy-bot: Thread summary saved to REL-2026-03-22. Canary status: PAUSED->PINNED->RAMPED(1.5%). Summary link: https://ci.redwood/logs/canary-2026-03-22/summary-1717601500

lina: Great work team. Quick triage prevented a rollback. We'll capture the postmortem action items after the window. :thumbsup:
